svg.title: Rules for AI Trading Agents: an open-source example
svg.desc: Open-source example. Rules for AI Trading Agents. Your own rules, checked before a paper order. An example from the Allocait team. Shared as is. Not an Allocait product. Not made or endorsed by Alpaca or Anthropic. An illustration of Claude's answer: 1 rule newly outside range, the Crypto band at 0% before and 9% after against a range of 0% to 7%, and the question whether to place it in your paper account, with No and Yes. Symbols and numbers are made up.
